title: From Existing Methods to New Research Ideas: Two Perspectives on Recursive Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2610.14625v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a route to AI systems that participate in their own continued development. Recent methods allow language agents to retain changes to their parameters, memory, skills, and code for subsequent execution and improvement. We examine how these methods can inform new research ideas through two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce a unified taxonomy with nine design dimensions organized into four groups: update targets, update organization, update schedule and scope, feedback and selection. This taxonomy places existing methods in a shared design space, where examining individual dimensions and their interactions can inspire new research ideas. Second, we examine how existing RSI methods draw on traditional deep learning, for example through optimization, regularization, data augmentation, continual learning, and adversarial learning. We develop further ideas by examining more specific learning

translated_title: 从现有方法到新研究思路：递归自我改进的两个视角
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）为AI系统参与自身的持续发展提供了一条路径。近期的方法使语言智能体能够保留对其参数、记忆、技能和代码的更改，以便后续执行和改进。我们通过两个互补的视角考察这些方法如何启发新的研究思路。首先，我们引入了一个统一的分类法，包含九个设计维度并分为四组：更新目标、更新组织、更新计划与范围、反馈与选择。该分类法将现有方法置于一个共享的设计空间中，在其中考察各个维度及其相互作用可以激发新的研究思路。其次，我们考察现有RSI方法如何借鉴传统深度学习，例如通过优化、正则化、数据增强、持续学习和对抗学习。我们通过考察更具体的学习……（摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个包含九个设计维度（分为四组）的递归自我改进（RSI）统一分类法，并通过考察现有方法与传统深度学习技术（如优化、正则化、持续学习等）的联系，为RSI领域的未来研究提供新思路。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified taxonomy for recursive self-improvement (RSI) with nine design dimensions organized into four groups, and examines how existing RSI methods draw on traditional deep learning techniques to inspire new research ideas.
